one_liner: Official Marketing API for managing LinkedIn advertising campaigns, reporting, matched audiences, and lead sync.
access_notes: Access to the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Program requires partner application approval.
verdict_reason: The API is fully documented and free to call, but requires approval through the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Program.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 three-legged (authorization code) flow — the flow every Marketing API call uses.
The official getting-access doc describes MDP as partner-application-gated without listing a dollar amount
As of September 2026 LinkedIn has not published an MCP server for Ads or for anything else.
